prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web product UI direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Design the PPTExtract default document entry surface using the “Stage Runway” structure. This is an internal desktop tool for experienced operators. The page must let them scan documents by current processing stage, upload a new .pptx, and open the item that needs their action.
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only. Carry over its application chrome, monitor-black and cool log-paper palette, compact Chinese workhorse typography, mono data labels, thin dividers, tight radii, teal selection, amber pending, red exclusion, and restrained engineering character. Do not copy its presentation content, three-column review-workbench topology, chart, AnyDoc panel, page rail, or existing card arrangement.
Structure: one 52px dark full-width status bar with “PPTExtract”, the current section “文档”, actor identity, search, and a compact teal “上传 PPTX” action at the far right. Below it, use the entire monitor-black canvas as three stacked, full-width horizontal runways—not a Kanban grid and not rounded floating cards. Each runway has a fixed left label strip and a dense right sequence of document rows: “待处理”, “处理中”, “可策展”. Show 2–4 realistic synthetic items with document title, version, page count or progress, last activity, and a textual state. The middle runway includes one clear persistent-task progress row with stage text such as “渲染 18 / 43”, but do not show infrastructure health. Empty space in a runway remains purposeful and labeled. One selected ready document gets a teal hairline and a quiet “打开” affordance. A slim bottom command strip supports keyboard scanning.
Real text to render where possible: “PPTExtract”, “文档”, “上传 PPTX”, “待处理”, “处理中”, “可策展”, “区域经营分析”, “2025 年产品路线”, “渲染 18 / 43”, “打开”, “最近活动”.
Style/medium: shippable realistic product UI screenshot, not concept art, not a poster.
Color palette: #171b20, #20262c, #293139, #e8ebec, #f6f7f7, #64bbb8, #276f70, #f2b84b, #5ca47d.
Materials/textures: flat dark instrument panel, pale log-paper labels, crisp hairline rails, mono transport data, only minimal depth for current focus.
Constraints: desktop-first at 1440px and credible at 1280px; status never communicated by color alone; upload remains visible but does not dominate; no health dashboard; no review workbench; no charts; no decorative illustration; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no giant rounded cards; no excessive pills; no marketing copy; no watermark.
